title: Toy vocabulary: does this sentence talk about money, time, or neither? (the engine's own test fixture)

kinds.label: Money
kinds.plain: Something that is paid, priced, owed or saved.
examples: How much does the monthly plan cost?
She paid with a credit card.
counterexamples: Please pay attention to the warning label.

kinds.label: Time
kinds.plain: When something happens, or for how long it lasts.
examples: Schedule the call for an hour.

na.plain: Small talk with no money or time in it.
